we found that the IG's prosodic and dialog structure cues are more informative for the IF's task performance than the IG's eye gaze and facial expressions cues, but that the IG's eye-gaze and facial expressions are more informative for predicting the IG's next turn than the IG's prosody and dialog structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of linguistic and non-linguistics modalities in multimodal communication is not only dependent on the task, but also on the discourse structure.
the use of communicational channels depends on the discourse structure.
the use of non-linguistc modalities is not random but is guided by the structure of the discourse and the time available to the speaker.
